name: Flare Dragon
description: A blazing dragon wrapped in solar flames. Flare Dragon channels the heat of the sun into every collision, burning through stamina and igniting the stadium with each revolution.

ability.name: Solar Flare
ability.description: On Attack win, applies Flare Burn to the enemy (20 dmg/turn for 2 turns). Burn stacks up to 3 times. Every 3rd burn application, Flare Dragon erupts — dealing 35 bonus true damage and healing 20 HP.

chain._note: Solar Flare: 20 dmg/turn burn on attack win
Solar Flare eruption: 35 true damage every 3rd burn

special_move.name: Flare Burst
special_move.description: Flare Dragon ignites in a solar explosion — two devastating strikes that scorch everything in the arena!
